question.en: What does sovereign cloud mean for Indonesia?
question.id: Apa arti sovereign cloud untuk Indonesia?

answer.en: A sovereign cloud keeps your data, control plane and operations within Indonesian jurisdiction, with full residency, governance and audit aligned to local regulation.
answer.id: Sovereign cloud menjaga data, control plane, dan operasi Anda tetap dalam yurisdiksi Indonesia, dengan residensi, tata kelola, dan audit penuh sesuai regulasi lokal.

question.en: How is Network as a Service (NaaS) different from traditional networking?
question.id: Apa beda Network as a Service (NaaS) dengan jaringan tradisional?

answer.en: NaaS delivers virtual networks, load balancing, firewall, SD-WAN and private connectivity as on-demand cloud services — fully software-defined and consumed via API.
answer.id: NaaS mengirimkan virtual network, load balancing, firewall, SD-WAN, dan konektivitas privat sebagai layanan cloud on-demand — software-defined penuh dan dikonsumsi via API.

question.en: How does Prominence support AI workloads?

answer.en: We provide GPU-ready compute, an LLM and generative AI model studio, vector database, feature store and a full DataWorks pipeline — all on the sovereign platform.
answer.id: Kami menyediakan komputasi siap-GPU, model studio LLM dan Generative AI, vector database, feature store, dan pipeline DataWorks penuh — semuanya di platform berdaulat.

question.en: What is the fastest way to get started?

answer.en: Begin with a Prominence Edge Assessment (2–4 weeks) — we map your environment, define a sovereign cloud roadmap and propose a 90-day pilot.
answer.id: Mulai dengan Prominence Edge Assessment (2–4 minggu) — kami memetakan environment Anda, menyusun roadmap sovereign cloud, dan mengusulkan pilot 90 hari.
